title: Touch request (POST <BASE>/touch)
description: Sent before each file edit (e.g. a PreToolUse hook). Adds the path to the session's OBSERVED footprint and returns a verdict. SANITIZATION IS MANDATORY: the server MUST read only session_id, tool_input.file_path, cwd, agent_id, agent_type and hook_event_name. Everything else — tool_input.old_string, tool_input.new_string, any file content — MUST be dropped before any processing and any storage (PROTOCOL.md §4).

tool_input.description: Raw client tool input. The server reads file_path and MUST discard every other key.

file_path.description: Path of the file about to be edited. REQUIRED. Absolute paths SHOULD be converted to repo-relative using cwd.

agent_id.description: Sub-agent identifier, when the edit comes from a sub-agent.

agent_type.description: Kind of agent client, as reported by the host.

hook_event_name.description: Name of the client event (e.g. PreToolUse). Defaults to PreToolUse when absent; echoed back in the hook response.
